title: Audio metadata state initialization
summary: Recovered the void thiscall leaf at VA 0x58b2c0: zero the packed prefix and six 32-bit fields, preserving byte +7. Direct original disassembly agrees with accepted assembly. Two direct callers initialize stack-local records. No external dependencies or cleanup are performed.
test_description: Differential GCC i386 tests against accepted original at its fixed VA: 256 constant byte patterns and 1024 deterministic varying patterns, each initialized twice; compare all 32 state bytes, the untouched byte +7 and 16-byte guards on both sides. Install test-owned FS backing and check its head after each original call.
known_limits: Field meanings and enclosing audio metadata ownership are unresolved; names describe offsets only.
Requires valid writable 32-byte storage. Null, inaccessible memory, concurrent observation and fault behavior are outside the C++ contract.

Original leaf incidentally preserves EAX, used across one caller; recovered void member models state effects and thiscall but does not promise volatile-register preservation for unrecovered binary callers.
No matching-byte claim or recovery of adjacent cleanup/callers.
